prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: one dedicated clinic ROOF concept mockup for a hand-painted 2D prison/factory exploration game.
Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET, an actual game screenshot of the clinic with its roof closed. Image 2 is a STYLE REFERENCE only, the approved medical-room architecture.
Primary request: redesign ONLY the large roof surface of the central/right clinic building in image 1 to fit the medical architectural style. Preserve the EXACT orthographic slightly elevated game camera, screen-aligned rectangular building outline, footprint, blue-grey continuous mitred perimeter coping, south entrance opening and open green glass door leaves, white-plaster/green-tile south wall face, pavement grid, surrounding left prison buildings and all outdoor objects. Do not expand the building or add isometric perspective. Roof must close/hide the entire interior; do not show beds or people through it.
New roof: pale cool grey with a subtle sage-green undertone, a smooth painted waterproof flat roof with only 3-4 broad roof-panel joints and discreet restrained edge wear, markedly cleaner and quieter than the rough beige concrete prison roof on the left. Thin blue-grey steel flashing runs continuously around its existing ivory perimeter rail, four natural 90-degree mitred corners without tall posts. Include ONE small low rectangular frosted-blue glass skylight (two panes, shallow steel frame, modest footprint about one sixth of roof width) in the upper-left interior roof area, ONE compact low blue-grey metal extractor/short vent pipe on a small square base in the upper-right roof area, and a tiny neat drainage outlet at a rear edge. Roof equipment is sparse, low and proportionate; the middle and lower roof are mostly open. Replace the existing domed industrial roof vent with the compact extractor. Match the modest aging, subdued medical sage/ivory/steel-blue palette and outlined painterly style of image 2.
Lighting: soft daylight matching image 1, discreet coherent shadows, crisp readable silhouettes at game size.
Constraints: no giant medical cross painted on roof, no signage on roof, no water tank, no air-conditioning array, no solar panels, no roof stairs, no railings, no extra buildings or plants, no raised pitched roof, no modern luxury hospital appearance, no carpet or floor-tile-like roof pattern, no dense speckle/grunge. No captions, callout arrows, HUD, watermark or decorative concept-sheet border. The result is a clean gameplay-compatible single scene concept with roof design clearly visible.
